label: FN1::ALK

sections.text: FN1 encodes fibronectin, an extracellular-matrix adhesion protein.
ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development.
The fusion joins an amino-terminal partner to the retained ALK kinase, producing abnormal ALK signaling. FN1::ALK is documented in inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor.
Crizotinib is US-approved for ALK-positive unresectable, recurrent or refractory inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor in patients aged at least 1 year.
